newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Sonae shares hit new high for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Sonae shares hit new high for 1996.

text.p: Shares in Portugal's biggest industrial group, Sonae Investimentos, hit a new high for 1996 of 4,840 escudos as investors anticipated the advantages of a planned reorganisation of the group, dealers said.
"There is still a lot of buying interest in Sonae Investimentos. Investors are fearless," said one dealer.
Dealers have said they expected the shares to reach an all-time high of 5,000 escudos by the end of this year.

Sonae has announced a reorganisation under which the holding company would keep the retail and real estate activities and a new company, Inparsa-Industria, would incorporate wood products, media, construction and other activities from January 1, 1997.
Sonae later eased to 4,830 escudos, up 83, in volume of 196,810 shares at 1550 GMT.
